patch_description:
For the antipodal construction, the squared distance ratio is exactly `(1 - max_abs_dot) / 2`, so minimizing the maximum absolute inter-line dot product is the exact hard objective rather than merely a surrogate. Replace the final single-candidate selection with a reproducible batched hard-objective polishing phase over all ten retained candidates.

Each iteration constructs deterministic soft-contact descent proposals plus tangent-space perturbations. Half of the perturbations affect all directions and half emphasize individual-line contact exchanges. A proposal is accepted only when its exact maximum absolute dot product improves, preserving the best hard ratio throughout and allowing the search to escape the contact patterns favored by the late log-sum-exp stages.
